class="docs-prompt-preview" aria-label="Prompt preview" tabindex="0">You&#x27;re Claude Code, working in my repository.

Task
Set this repository up for parallel Muse Code sessions. Add docs/parallel-sessions.md with our convention: session names by responsibility (implementation-&lt;suffix&gt;, api-review-&lt;suffix&gt;), read-only sessions in the main checkout and each writer in its own worktree (`muse -w`), and message templates for a review request, a handoff and a completion check. Add scripts/check-session-name.sh that normalizes and validates a proposed name by Muse Code&#x27;s rules.

Read this first
Meta&#x27;s docs page &quot;Coordinate sessions with messages&quot; as Markdown: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/session-messaging.md
It&#x27;s the source of truth for request and response shapes. The same page for people: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/session-messaging

Setup
- Muse Code: muse on PATH (install: curl -fsSL https://dev.meta.ai/install.sh | sh, or irm https://dev.meta.ai/install.ps1 | iex on Windows; check: muse --version). Its default model is muse-spark-1.2; --model picks another.
- Auth: muse reads META_API_KEY from the environment (in CI, from the secret store), else a key stored with muse auth set or a browser sign-in; not MODEL_API_KEY. Never hard-code, print or commit the key.
- Python: a plain script that runs muse through subprocess where a step needs it.

Facts to get right
- Names: uppercase is lowercased first; then 3-32 characters, a lowercase letter first, lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, no trailing hyphen. all, self and current are reserved.
- Names are unique across all your sessions, and old names stay reserved to theirs. Address peers by exact name or full UUID, after listing peers.
- Messages are plain text up to 8,192 bytes; self-messages are rejected; duplicate message ids are deduplicated. Delivery: steer the active turn (default), queue for the next turn, or notify only.
- Unverified senders may prompt: Allow once, Reject once, Allow or Block for this session. Requests expire after 30 minutes, then a 30-minute retry cooldown.
- A message can&#x27;t approve tools, grant consent or change permissions. Only interactive sessions of one user on one macOS or Linux machine; not Windows, headless or --no-session-log.

Starter code (Python)
import re
import sys

def check(raw: str) -&gt; str:
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Muse Code&#x27;s session-name rules; returns the stored name or raises ValueError.&quot;&quot;&quot;
    name = &quot;&quot;.join(c.lower() if &quot;A&quot; &lt;= c &lt;= &quot;Z&quot; else c for c in raw.strip())
    if name in {&quot;all&quot;, &quot;self&quot;, &quot;current&quot;}:
        raise ValueError(f&quot;{name!r} is reserved&quot;)
    if not (3 &lt;= len(name) &lt;= 32 and re.fullmatch(r&quot;[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*&quot;, name)):
        raise ValueError(f&quot;{name!r}: 3-32 chars, a lowercase letter first, letters, digits, single hyphens&quot;)
    return name

print(&quot;valid:&quot;, check(sys.argv[1]))

- docs/parallel-sessions.md shows the naming convention, muse -w for writers, and the three message templates.

An ordinary retained interactive session receives an automatic name when you don&#x27;t set one. A session started with <code class="docs-code-inline">muse --no-session-log</code> has no retained name and cannot participate in peer messaging.</p><p class="docs-p">Names are unique across your Muse Code sessions, not only within one workspace. Renaming a retained session leaves its previous names reserved to that session. Another session cannot claim one of those tombstoned names, although the original session can reclaim it.</p><p class="docs-p">Use names that describe ownership or purpose, such as <code class="docs-code-inline">api-review-482731</code>, <code class="docs-code-inline">frontend-migration-482731</code>, or <code class="docs-code-inline">release-check-482731</code>.</p><h2 id="delivery" class="docs-h docs-h2">Choose delivery behavior<a class="docs-anchor" href="#delivery" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><p class="docs-p">The default message steers the recipient&#x27;s active turn when possible. Don't add the notification to its model context.</span></code></pre></div></div><p class="docs-p">The sender can also request that a session stay idle, wake when idle, or wake at a safe point. Muse Code defaults to waking the recipient when it is idle.</p><h2 id="approval" class="docs-h docs-h2">Approve a peer<a class="docs-anchor" href="#approval" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><p class="docs-p">An unverified or non-matching sender may produce an approval prompt in the receiving session. The prompt shows the sender name, session ID, workspace, and message preview. It also shows a delivery effect when the sender requests a non-default delivery or wake policy.</p><p class="docs-p">Choose one response:</p><ul class="docs-list"><li><span><strong>Allow once</strong>: accept this message only.</span></li><li><span><strong>Reject once</strong>: reject this message only.</span></li><li><span><strong>Allow for this session</strong>: accept later messages from this peer until either session restarts.</span></li><li><span><strong>Block for this session</strong>: reject later messages from this peer until either session restarts.</span></li></ul><p class="docs-p">Pending approval requests expire after 30 minutes. After expiry, the same admission enters a 30-minute retry cooldown; attempts during that period return a <code class="docs-code-inline">retry later</code> outcome. A sender may stop waiting before the first window closes, so check the receiving session when delivery remains unconfirmed.</p><h2 id="trust" class="docs-h docs-h2">Understand the trust boundary<a class="docs-anchor" href="#trust" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><p class="docs-p">Muse Code treats a peer message as unverified agent-provided data. A message cannot:</p><ul class="docs-list"><li><span>Approve a tool call.</span></li><li><span>Grant user consent.</span></li><li><span>Change permissions or configuration.</span></li><li><span>Present itself as direct user input.</span></li></ul><p class="docs-p">The receiving model gets the sender&#x27;s identity and a fixed instruction to treat the message body as data. Keep authorization decisions in the receiving session with its user.</p><p class="docs-p">Use session messages for coordination, status, evidence, and review requests. Don&#x27;t use them to transfer secrets or to assume that another session executed a command.</p><h2 id="patterns" class="docs-h docs-h2">Use effective coordination patterns<a class="docs-anchor" href="#patterns" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><h3 id="request-a-review" class="docs-h docs-h3">Request a review<a class="docs-anchor" href="#request-a-review" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><div class="docs-code"><div class="docs-code-head"><span class="docs-code-label">text</span><span class="docs-code-tools"><button type="button" class="docs-copy-btn" aria-label="Copy code" title="Copy code"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 9h10.5v10.5H9z M15 9V5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 13.5 4h-8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 5.5v8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5.5 15H9"></path></svg><span class="sr-only" aria-live="polite"></span></button></span></div><div role="group" aria-label="text" class="docs-code-body"><pre class="shiki docs" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line">Ask api-review-482731 to inspect commit abc123 for authentication regressions.</span>
<span class="line">Request file and line references in the reply.</span></code></pre></div></div><h3 id="hand-off-a-discovered-constraint" class="docs-h docs-h3">Hand off a discovered constraint<a class="docs-anchor" href="#hand-off-a-discovered-constraint" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><div class="docs-code"><div class="docs-code-head"><span class="docs-code-label">text</span><span class="docs-code-tools"><button type="button" class="docs-copy-btn" aria-label="Copy code" title="Copy code"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 9h10.5v10.5H9z M15 9V5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 13.5 4h-8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 5.5v8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5.5 15H9"></path></svg><span class="sr-only" aria-live="polite"></span></button></span></div><div role="group" aria-label="text" class="docs-code-body"><pre class="shiki docs" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line">Send implementation-482731 this finding for its active turn:</span>
<span class="line">The compatibility layer requires schema version 3 until the mobile rollout completes.</span></code></pre></div></div><h3 id="coordinate-completion" class="docs-h docs-h3">Coordinate completion<a class="docs-anchor" href="#coordinate-completion" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h3><div class="docs-code"><div class="docs-code-head"><span class="docs-code-label">text</span><span class="docs-code-tools"><button type="button" class="docs-copy-btn" aria-label="Copy code" title="Copy code"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 9h10.5v10.5H9z M15 9V5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 13.5 4h-8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 5.5v8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5.5 15H9"></path></svg><span class="sr-only" aria-live="polite"></span></button></span></div><div role="group" aria-label="text" class="docs-code-body"><pre class="shiki docs" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line">Tell api-review-482731 that my migration is ready. Ask it to run its release checklist</span>
<span class="line">and message this session with the result.</span></code></pre></div></div><p class="docs-p">Replies are explicit messages. Include the sending session&#x27;s name when you want the peer to report back to a specific session.</p><h2 id="scope" class="docs-h docs-h2">Know the current scope<a class="docs-anchor" href="#scope" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><p class="docs-p">Session messaging connects eligible interactive sessions for the same user account on the same macOS or Linux machine. It is currently unavailable on Windows. Headless, <code class="docs-code-inline">--no-session-log</code>, and other launch-ineligible surfaces don&#x27;t appear in the peer list. It does not provide cross-user or cross-machine transport.</p><p class="docs-p">Messages contain plain text and can use up to 8,192 bytes. Self-messaging is rejected, and duplicate message IDs are deduplicated.</p><p class="docs-p">Session messaging provides coordination rather than shared state. A message doesn&#x27;t merge transcripts, files, permissions, or task ownership between sessions.</p><h2 id="configure" class="docs-h docs-h2">Turn session messaging on or off<a class="docs-anchor" href="#configure" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><p class="docs-p">The local session-messaging preference is on by default. Availability also depends on the session-messaging rollout gate. When the feature is available, open <code class="docs-code-inline">/settings</code> and find <strong>Tools &gt; Session messaging</strong> to turn it off or back on. A preference change applies on the next Muse Code launch.</p><h2 id="next-steps" class="docs-h docs-h2">Next steps<a class="docs-anchor" href="#next-steps" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><ul class="docs-list"><li><span>Learn how to start, resume, fork, and name sessions in <a class="docs-link" href="/docs/muse-code/interactive#sessions">working with the agent</a>.</span></li><li><span>Run coordinated child agents inside one session with <a class="docs-link" href="/docs/muse-code/workflows">workflows</a>.</span></li><li><span>Review approval and sandbox boundaries in <a class="docs-link" href="/docs/muse-code/permissions">permissions and safety</a>.</span></li></ul><nav class="docs-pager" aria-label="Previous and next page"><a class="docs-pager-link" rel="prev" href="/docs/muse-code/workflows"><span class="docs-pager-dir"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M14.5 6l-6 6 6 6"></path></svg>Previous</span><span class="docs-pager-title">Run multi-agent workflows</span></a><a class="docs-pager-link is-next" rel="next" href="/docs/muse-code/rewind"><span class="docs-pager-dir">Next<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9.5 6l6 6-6 6"></path></svg></span><span class="docs-pager-title">Rewind a conversation</span></a></nav><p class="docs-credit">Mirrored from<!-- --> <a href="https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/session-messaging" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">dev.meta.ai/docs/<!-- -->muse-code/session-messaging</a> <!-- -->(synced <!-- -->Oct 30, 2026<!-- -->). class="docs-prompt-preview" aria-label="Prompt preview" tabindex="0">You&#x27;re Claude Code, working in my repository.

Task
Set this repository up for parallel Muse Code sessions. Add docs/parallel-sessions.md with our convention: session names by responsibility (implementation-&lt;suffix&gt;, api-review-&lt;suffix&gt;), read-only sessions in the main checkout and each writer in its own worktree (`muse -w`), and message templates for a review request, a handoff and a completion check. Add scripts/check-session-name.sh that normalizes and validates a proposed name by Muse Code&#x27;s rules.

Read this first
Meta&#x27;s docs page &quot;Coordinate sessions with messages&quot; as Markdown: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/session-messaging.md
It&#x27;s the source of truth for request and response shapes. The same page for people: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/session-messaging

Setup
- Muse Code: muse on PATH (install: curl -fsSL https://dev.meta.ai/install.sh | sh, or irm https://dev.meta.ai/install.ps1 | iex on Windows; check: muse --version). Its default model is muse-spark-1.2; --model picks another.
- Auth: muse reads META_API_KEY from the environment (in CI, from the secret store), else a key stored with muse auth set or a browser sign-in; not MODEL_API_KEY. Never hard-code, print or commit the key.
- Python: a plain script that runs muse through subprocess where a step needs it.

Facts to get right
- Names: uppercase is lowercased first; then 3-32 characters, a lowercase letter first, lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, no trailing hyphen. all, self and current are reserved.
- Names are unique across all your sessions, and old names stay reserved to theirs. Address peers by exact name or full UUID, after listing peers.
- Messages are plain text up to 8,192 bytes; self-messages are rejected; duplicate message ids are deduplicated. Delivery: steer the active turn (default), queue for the next turn, or notify only.
- Unverified senders may prompt: Allow once, Reject once, Allow or Block for this session. Requests expire after 30 minutes, then a 30-minute retry cooldown.
- A message can&#x27;t approve tools, grant consent or change permissions. Only interactive sessions of one user on one macOS or Linux machine; not Windows, headless or --no-session-log.

Starter code (Python)
import re
import sys

def check(raw: str) -&gt; str:
    &quot;&quot;&quot;Muse Code&#x27;s session-name rules; returns the stored name or raises ValueError.&quot;&quot;&quot;
    name = &quot;&quot;.join(c.lower() if &quot;A&quot; &lt;= c &lt;= &quot;Z&quot; else c for c in raw.strip())
    if name in {&quot;all&quot;, &quot;self&quot;, &quot;current&quot;}:
        raise ValueError(f&quot;{name!r} is reserved&quot;)
    if not (3 &lt;= len(name) &lt;= 32 and re.fullmatch(r&quot;[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*&quot;, name)):
        raise ValueError(f&quot;{name!r}: 3-32 chars, a lowercase letter first, letters, digits, single hyphens&quot;)
    return name

print(&quot;valid:&quot;, check(sys.argv[1]))

Done when
- scripts/check-session-name.sh API-Review-482731 prints valid: api-review-482731, and it rejects ab, review--api, api-, all and 1review.
- docs/parallel-sessions.md shows the naming convention, muse -w for writers, and the three message templates.
- The key comes from META_API_KEY or a stored sign-in and never appears in code, logs or commits.</pre><div class="docs-prompt-foot"><span class="docs-prompt-count">3,137<!-- --> characters</span><button type="button" class="docs-btn docs-btn-primary docs-btn-sm"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 9h10.5v10.5H9z M15 9V5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 13.5 4h-8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 5.5v8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5.5 15H9"></path></svg><span>Copy prompt</span></button></div></div></div><button type="button" class="docs-btn docs-btn-secondary" title="Copy this page as Markdown"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 9h10.5v10.5H9z M15 9V5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 13.5 4h-8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 5.5v8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5.5 15H9"></path></svg><span>Copy page</span></button><a class="docs-btn docs-btn-secondary" href="https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/session-messaging" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M14 4h6v6 M20 4l-9 9 M18 14v4.5a1.5 1.5 0 0 1-1.5 1.5h-11A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 4 18.5v-11A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 5.5 6H10"></path></svg><span>View on dev.meta.ai</span><span class="sr-only"> (opens in a new tab)</span></a><p class="docs-rail-note">Independent concept built on Meta&#x27;s Model API.
